items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Him and Lil' Keg and Bob would get together, you had a good line.

ctx.x: Good blues trumpet player. Yeah, he was good.

Him and Lil' Keg and Bob would get together, you had a good line. What about getting that low on trumpet, you know, like Toka does? Many of the other ones do that? Yeah. You know, hit them pedal notes like he does? Yeah, the D. Yeah, the D. The D would play real low then? Yeah, the D can get all low. Bob Anthony. Bob Anthony. And they used to use that rubber too, you know, they had a rubber, like the toilet flushed it, they cut it, made a wah-wah. They did wah-wah you with that. They could play now.
They used any other kind of mutes, marching them?
